category_title: Gifted student with impulse control disorder and depression exhibiting perfectionism and anger fits
minimal_context: The student is working on a mind-games paper with varying levels of difficulty in a classroom setting right before lunch.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The application time is over. Please pass your mind-games working papers to the front so we can get ready for lunch.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Holding onto the paper) I am not returning it. I have to answer all of the questions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just hand in what you have finished so far.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I will solve all the questions. I am not ending the activity without completing all of them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for lunch now, you need to give me the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying loudly) I will not return my paper unless I solve all the questions! I cannot do it but I will!

TUTOR: It is time for lunch now, you need to give me the paper.

task.content: Working paper consisting of mind-games prepared under three groups with varying levels of difficulty

context.environment: Classroom during the Development and Science Program
context.time_context: When the application was over, right before lunch

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the application was over and he was asked to return his paper
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Did not want to return his paper and started crying that he would not return his paper unless he solved all the questions. In a high voice, saying 'I cannot do it but I will!'
related_quotes: I cannot do it but I will!

behavior_patterns.condition: When he has not ended the activity without completing all of the questions
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Cried until he answered all of the questions
